title: Phoenix and the Muse
description: A large mythical phoenix with golden, blue and fiery red feathers dominates the foreground, wings spread and one talon visible. In the upper background, a man in a red shirt reaches toward a glowing white classical statue of a woman as a horned demonic creature with a dripping tentacle looms above them amid swirling smoke and flames.
